solves.reasoning: Passage discusses trade barriers and competitive prices. (A) barriers(장벽) exist — not bridges. (B) competitive prices — not cooperative. (C) savings reinvested — not redistributed.
(A) Transaction costs are significant(상당한) — not insignificant. (B) costs disappear with common currency — not increase. (C) useless costs turn into productive — not destructive.
(A) hedging funds — hedging is the financial term, not spending. (B) productivity and innovation — not imitation. (C) strong economic foundation — not limitation.
②trivial is wrong: the passage says transaction costs are significant(상당한), not trivial(사소한). The context requires significance.
③accumulate is wrong: the passage says transaction costs disappear with a common currency, not accumulate. All others are contextually appropriate.
④shrink is wrong: the passage says whole economies benefit and grow, not shrink. Other markers (exchange costs, innovation, useless) are correct.
Blank is 'many of the ___ to trade exist'. Context clearly requires barriers. Bridges/passages/entries do not fit the negative trade context.
Blank is '___ costs are significant for companies'. The rest of the sentence details exchange, converting, hedging funds — all transaction costs. Transaction fits perfectly.
Blank is 'firms' ___ and innovation'. Productivity pairs naturally with innovation in business context. Other choices (popularity, possibility, profitability) don't pair as naturally.
significant = considerable(상당한). minimal is opposite. optional and temporary are unrelated.
unifying = integrating(통합하다). separating is antonym. regulating and eliminating have different meanings.
foundation = basis(기초/기반). ceiling(상한), surface(표면), boundary(경계) are not synonyms of foundation.
useless의 반의어는 valuable(가치 있는). pointless/wasteful are synonyms; harmful is a different negative dimension.
competitive의 반의어: inferior(열등한/경쟁력 없는). aggressive/dominant are in the competitive direction; strategic is unrelated.
(A) 'costs turn into savings' — turn into = 변하다(transform). (B) 'turn to page 45' — turn to = 펼치다(flip to). Option ④ (A)변하다 — (B)펼치다 is correct.
영영 정의: 'money put back into a business to help it grow' = reinvestment(재투자). Transaction/foundation/currency don't match this definition.
produce → productivity(명사). Context: 'firms' ___ and innovation'. Needs a noun meaning productivity.
unity → unify → unifying. 'By ___ some of the currencies' requires gerund after preposition By.

Blank replaces 'Transaction' costs. Sentence structure '___ are significant for companies — not only exchange costs but also converting, paying, hedging funds'. Korean choice 거래 비용 = transaction costs.
Blank fills 'a common currency provides for ___'. The passage concludes with 'a strong economic foundation that all can benefit from' = 강력한 경제적 기반.
